scope: Port Qualcomm DDR cooling device (ddr_cdev) to native 7.3 ICC/thermal with acknowledged votes; private recorded ICC provider only
regressions_before: First run: all 14 cases failed in teardown/probe expectations because the private ICC provider lacked get_bw; native ICC then conservatively keeps an INT_MAX boot request until sync_state, so provider users/peak never returned to recorded zero. Fixed in the fixture (recorded zero hardware vote), not by weakening driver checks.
implemented: Factory semantics kept: state0=0, stateN=freq*bus-width, single peak vote on interconnects path
Validate #cooling-cells==2, nonzero width/frequency, u32 array, multiplication overflow; reject missing/NULL ICC path
Mutex-serialized callbacks; cur_state reported only after acknowledged icc_set_bw; failed vote retried by drained delayed work and cancelled by a newer acknowledged target
devm order: ICC release action registered before managed thermal cdev so callbacks drain before icc_put zero-vote/free
verified: 14 KUnit cases on 4-CPU QEMU with real OF/platform/devres/ICC core/thermal registry: probe, vote 3552 and release to 0, idempotent repeat, -EINVAL bound, failed vote -> EAGAIN -> retry, pending cancel, pending remove, 3x rebind, multi-level table, 6 malformed DT rejections, initial vote failure and reattach
Saved 6.12 DT: one active node, width4, table<888>, mc_virt MASTER_LLCC->SLAVE_EBI1, one passive map (ddr zone, 100C/5C hysteresis, state1..1); fixture reuses the same values/IDs
ddr_cdev is in saved vendor.modules.load and loaded on 6.12
limits: Physical qnoc/RPMh/CRM DDR actuation and the unit interpretation of 3552 on alor firmware are unverified
qnoc-alor provider behaviour with this consumer was not co-tested; provider is a private RAM fixture
Whole-board boot, remaining drivers/DT/vendor_boot/dtbo/DLKM/SELinux and daily use remain
